English: Field Hut
A humble thatched shelter where the earliest settlers rest, store tools, and oversee the first furrows of land.
Irrigation Ditch
Simple hand-dug channels bringing water to crops, increasing yield and resilience against drought.
Crop Plot
Well-marked plots with primitive fences, more organized planting, and the beginnings of surplus.
Vineyard Patch
Rows of hardy vines, tended by serfs, producing wine for both profit and hospitality.
Dairy Farm
A cluster of timber sheds and enclosed pastures for cattle and goats, providing milk and cheese to the estate and boosting food security.
Threshing Barn
A large timber barn for processing grain, ensuring better storage and reducing losses to rot or theft.
Market Farm
A productive estate with a bustling market green, attracting merchants and increasing commerce across the region.
Tenant Village
A sizable settlement of tenant farmers, with stone cottages and communal facilities, providing stability and a larger pool for levies and duties.
Estate Granary
A massive stone granary with guards, providing for the estate in times of famine and enabling the lord to support a substantial garrison.
Lords Grange
A grand, fortified grange at the heart of the demesne, overseeing all production, securing the estate’s wealth, and symbolizing the lord’s authority.
